load_tablebert_model: load a TableBertModel from a model path and config file using TableBertModel.load()
from_pretrained_tablebert: load a pretrained TableBertModel from a model name or path using TableBertModel.from_pretrained()
encode_table_contexts: encode table contexts and Table objects into tensors using the encode method
get_bert_model: access the underlying base BERT model via the bert property on a TableBertModel instance
get_model_device: get the device a TableBertModel is running on via the device property
